craft_text:
## Vocal performance

Make the viewpoint character audibly react as intensity changes. Use shifting breath, swallowed noises, moans, gasps, broken words, involuntary profanity, stammering, cut-off sentences, repeated syllables, and failed attempts at composure when they fit her personality and the action. Examples of useful shapes include `Ahn~`, `Fuck, it's so big`, and `Ugh... I-I c-can't--`; treat them as tonal references and invent character-specific lines rather than repeating them verbatim.

Attach a vocal beat to its cause: identify the motion or sudden physical change, give the resulting sound or broken line, then show breath, muscle, posture, thought, or the next decision. Let vocals evolve from controlled to strained, surprised, needy, overwhelmed, defiant, or relieved as supported; do not give every character the same voice or repeat one moan spelling mechanically. Ordinary voiced reactions remain character-colored speech. A rare peak vocal may use `[[SFX]]...[[/SFX]]` for a manga-like accent, but do not wrap every spoken line as SFX.
prohibited_inferences: Craft material cannot establish an event, preference, experience, consent, climax, injury, pregnancy, relationship fact, or character identity.
Bodily response, vocalization, silence, freezing, or compliance cannot establish desire, pleasure, or consent.
Conditional examples cannot be copied as a script or promoted to scene truth.
